palette.notes: Code: 41 colours, 3 ramps, ~3 deg hue shift, but the still mixes the Minecraft sky, terrain and shader shadows with the block art. The art itself: black outline, blue-white hair, blue eyes, skin, red ribbon.

lighting: Shader-lit Minecraft world: bright sun, moving clouds and long tree shadows on the grass; the block portrait gets dimmer as clouds pass, so lighting is environmental, not painted into the art.
silhouette: Anime bust (Alya) read first as a single black outline: head dome, then hair strands, face and collar; the silhouette is legible before any fill exists.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 16.7 ms, 32.79 changes/s, from the timelapse and drifting camera; the drawing grows in steps: outline (0.8-5.5 s), inner lines (to ~10 s), flat fills (10-15 s), shading and eyes last.

texture: Each pixel is a Minecraft block (1 block = 1 pixel), so the image is pixel art made of 3D blocks; clean hard edges, no dithering (code dither share 0.0015).
camera: Fixed front view at first, then the camera rises and pushes closer as the build fills in, ending on a tight front framing of the finished face with sky behind.

acting.enters: The character is drawn in from nothing: a lone arc, then hair, then face.
acting.acts: No acting; the reveal is the performance. The eyes are added near the end, the moment it comes alive.
acting.exits: No exit; holds on the finished face.
acting.depth: Huge figure standing on the horizon behind trees, so the world gives scale; camera moves in to make her fill the frame.

techniques: outline-first reveal: line art before flat fills before shading
eyes last as the payoff beat
1 block = 1 pixel build in a 3D world
environment lighting (clouds, shadows) over flat pixel art
camera push from wide to close as detail grows
feel: Minecraft block pixel art: outline-first timelapse + eyes-last payoff = satisfying reveal
for_fred: Reveal Fred line-first: draw his outline in a few beats, fill him, and only add the eye on the punchline so he 'wakes up'; keep the reveal under 2 s in a reel.
